title: Hearty German Casserole
description: A comforting, cheesy casserole packed with ground beef and veggies, perfect for a chilly evening. Serve warm and enjoy!
instructions: Cook ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add diced onion and cook until softened.
Stir in canned diced tomatoes, casserole seasoning, and molten cheddar cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 20x20cm baking dish.
Arrange cubed German wheat bread on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and top with sliced avocado.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
